However, I will attempt to provide a rough, generalized translation based on the typical uses of the words and phrases visible:
 
1. "On that day, from the heaven-earth it (was) brought/made."
2. "The reed on that day, the reed from heaven to earth was brought/made."
3. "[In the year] that (someone was) named, its name was chosen."
4. "[The princes] were bound towards it."
5. "The wives of Inanna were established therein."
6. "The wives of Inanna brought joy between heaven and earth."
7. "The wives of [unknown] were born and raised."
8. "The god's special beer X X (perhaps a gap or damaged tablet), in Unug (one of the Sumerian cities) was distributed."
9. "The gods, great-great, of great wisdom, the young gods were very wise."
10. "The river god roared mightily, its mountains trembled greatly."
11. "The god of storms thundered greatly, its life words (decisions) were judiciously discussed."
12. "In the distant broad fields the highest gods were exalting."
13. "Enki of the temple engur, whose great sanctuary in Eridu, not a single god knows its interior."
14. "Our place was tenderly cared for, and no one experienced hardship."
15. "The god Erra thundered mightily, strongly placing its foundation neck-deep."
16. "The man was tenderly cared for in our place, he did not experience hardship."
17. "Namma bore Palil for the great gods."
18. "Erra's calamity, their offspring, was exalted."
19. "[Someone] named and [someone] decreed lameness."
20. "[Unknown] firmly established [unknown]."
21. "The runner conveyed the message, his twin was very envious X in guidance doubled."
